compiler.validation: one compile and one retained embed session for the normal provider path

evidence.summary: Execution reports retained-embed-batch, batch_size 6, and reused_session true.
Representative language tests report retained-embed-batch with batch_size 2 and reused_session true.

reproduction.instructions: Run mncs-test self-tests with MNCS_EMBED_LIBRARY set and inspect execution.mode, batch_size, and session.reused_session.

summary: The old subprocess-per-test architecture no longer governs normal execution: mncs-test compiles one test artifact, opens one retained embed session, and sends a batch. Process supervision remains only for compiler launch, timeout enforcement, and the explicit no-embed fallback.

workaround.description: Python remains at the process-launch/timeout/capture boundary and preserves a per-test mncs execute fallback when the embed library is unavailable.
